title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Tunicates
author: Marta Wawrzyniak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b5axq2fn
materials: Quantify the DNA concentration and quality.

steps.title: Clean slide and isolate colony
steps.instruction: Clean the slide from which the colony will be taken, then isolate a cleaned colony consisting of approximately 20–30 zooids.

steps.title: Incubate sample at 55 °C (10 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate the isolated colony at 55 °C for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of Proteinase K to the sample and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Transfer to tube and spin
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and spin at maximum speed for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Homogenize in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample in 500 µL of TE buffer using a sterile plastic pestle.

steps.title: Remove excess water
steps.instruction: Remove any excess water from the homogenized sample.

steps.title: Incubate at 55 °C (15 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 55 °C for 15 minutes (00:15:00).

steps.title: Add phenol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of phenol to the tube and mix well by inverting until the phases are completely mixed.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect upper phase
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 rcf (temperature not specified) for 5 minutes (00:05:00), then carefully transfer 500 µL of the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Add phenol/chloroform and mix
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of a 1:1 (v/v) phenol/chloroform mixture and mix well by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect upper phase
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 rcf (temperature not specified) for 5 minutes (00:05:00), then carefully collect 300 µL of the upper phase into a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with acetate and ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 3 M sodium acetate and 600 µL of ethanol to the collected phase and mix gently by inverting the tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 rcf (temperature not specified) for 3 minutes (00:03:00) to pellet nucleic acids, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash pellet with cold ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 1 mL of cold ethanol (‑20 °C) and invert gently several times.

steps.title: Dry pellet upside-down (10 min)
steps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the ethanol supernatant, then place the tube upside‑down on a paper towel and let it dry for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in RNase‑free water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet gently in RNase‑free water and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Add SDS and RNase, vortex
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of SDS and 4 µL of RNase to the resuspended DNA and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Final spin to clarify
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 rcf (temperature not specified) for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Store DNA at -20 °C or -80 °C
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA at –20 °C for short‑term storage or at –80 °C for longer storage.
